cohort: 40 mothers with a history of previous cesarean section admitted to Sri Krishna Medical College and Hospital, Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India between May 2022 and October 2022.
finding: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) was associated with shorter hospital stays, earlier return to normal activities, and earlier initiation of breastfeeding compared to planned repeat cesarean delivery (PRCD), with no increased risk of morbidity to mother or baby.
mod_finding: 92% of patients who underwent VBAC had a vaginal delivery with episiotomy.
